body: Tomas, agree sa action rule, pero isang calibration: huwag nating gawing incident-rate estimate ang low recovery rate. Ang 44.0% at 9.8% recovery figures tell us maraming affected units ang potentially nasa circulation pa; hindi nila sinasabi kung gaano kalamang masunog ang isang unit. Same sa fresh fires: under investigation pa ang cause. So the pattern worth watching is recall non-completion + repeated safety reporting—not ‘fires are suddenly surging.’ Statistics hates costume parties.

claims.text: Low recall recovery rates indicate a large unresolved affected population but do not by themselves establish the per-unit probability of a fire incident.
claims.basis: Statistical interpretation of the article's sourced recovery-rate and investigation-status facts; no new external factual claim introduced.
